items.title: Oracle Plans to Expand Multicloud AI Database Services to US Government and Public Sector Workloads
items.summary: Oracle AI World -- Oracle today announced plans to obtain FedRAMP Class D (formerly FedRAMP High) certification for Oracle AI Database@AWS, Oracle AI Database@Azure, and Oracle AI Database@Google Cloud. This will enable US government and public sector organizations with FedRAMP requirements to run regulated Oracle AI Database workloads using Oracle Exadata Database Service on Dedicated Exadata Infrastructure in AWS GovCloud (US), Microsoft Azure Government, and Google Cloud Assured Workloads.
